input.answer: The job vacancy rate for Canada in August 2026 was 2.9%, from Statistics Canada table 14-10-0371 (job vacancies, payroll employees, and job vacancy rate by province and territory, monthly, unadjusted for seasonality). This is the unadjusted series, so it is not seasonally adjusted. The rate was 2.8% in July 2026, so it rose 0.1 percentage points (2.9 − 2.8 = 0.1). Earlier in the series, it was 3.1% in May 2026 and 2.9% in June 2026.
